messages:
Liam (CS): Heads-up — AcmeBio's AP just replied to our invoice draft. They said they will not accept any invoices unless we include their internal "Order Authorization Number (OAN)" and a signed approval from procurement. Quote from AP email below.

AcmeCorp AP (snippet):
```
From: ap@acmebio.com
Subject: Billing requirement - OAN

Please note: We will reject invoices that do not include our Order Authorization Number (OAN) in the invoice header AND a signed procurement approval attached. No invoices will be processed without both.
Please confirm you will hold billing until we provide the OAN and signed approval.
```

Jonah (Support): Got it. Do we already have an OAN stored anywhere (sales notes / contract)? Is OAN equivalent to a PO for them or a separate field? Tagging @Nina to confirm billing process.

Nina (Billing): We don't have an OAN for this account. This sounds like a customer-mandated field separate from our usual "customer_po". Options:
1) Hold invoice until they provide OAN + signed approval (we can mark as "on hold" in billing).
2) Issue a proforma so they can get internal approvals (no accounting impact).
3) If urgent, accept card payment / auto-pay while we wait for their docs.

I can put the invoice on hold now. Internal command we use:

```bash
# mark invoice on hold (internal billing tool)
rbill hold create --account acmebio --reason "Awaiting OAN + signed approval" --notes "Customer mandate from AP email"
```

Kara (Finance Ops): If we mirror this in Stripe/our ledger please add metadata: `oan_required: true`, `hold_reason: "Awaiting OAN and signed approval"`, and populate `hold_ticket` with the internal task ID. Also ask Sales for the exact OAN label they expect (some customers call it "OAN", others "Order Auth#"). I can create a proforma (PRO-98765) and attach the email.

Jonah (Support): I'll send the customer a short confirmation email letting them know we'll hold billing and requesting the OAN + signed approval. Draft I plan to send:

"Hi <Name>,

Thanks — we received your note. Per your instruction we'll place the invoice on hold and can issue a proforma for your approvals. Can you confirm the exact OAN format (numeric/alpha) and the contact who will send the signed approval? Once we have OAN + signed doc we'll finalize the invoice.

Best, Jonah (Redwood Support)"

Liam (CS): Please use this template for Sales outreach when they call procurement: include the exact contract reference, the invoice draft link, and a one-line summary of the AP requirement. Example:

"We're holding invoicing per AcmeCorp AP until they provide their Order Authorization Number (OAN) and a signed approval. Please request OAN + approval and paste the OAN into the billing system's 'external_order_id' field so billing can proceed."

procure-bot: Task created FIN-4521 assigned to Kara (Finance Ops), due 2026-03-18.

Nina (Billing): Done — I put the invoice draft on hold in the billing UI and generated proforma PRO-98765. Set metadata: `oan_required=true`, `hold_ticket=FIN-4521`. Left note: "Awaiting OAN + signed procurement approval from AcmeCorp AP (email on file)."

Kara (Finance Ops): I created the proforma and uploaded the AP email as an attachment. Also added instructions for ledger: if OAN is provided, populate `external_order_id` and remove the hold; if no OAN within 30 days, send reminder and escalate.

Jonah (Support): Thanks — I'll update the support ticket and nudge Sales to collect the OAN. If Sales wants the exact wording to ask for, use the customer's phrase: "Order Authorization Number (OAN) — required for invoice acceptance."

Liam (CS): Perfect. I'll follow up with the customer contact and log the next touch. Leaving this thread open until we have the OAN. :thumbsup:

Nina (Billing): Closing loop for now — invoice status: ON_HOLD, proforma: PRO-98765, hold_ticket: FIN-4521. Ping me once OAN arrives and I'll release and send the invoice.

Kara (Finance Ops): Noted. If someone needs, I can add a billing note showing the exact customer wording so next invoices include OAN in the header.

Jonah (Support): Copy — moving to status: waiting_on_customer.

Liam (CS): Thanks everyone.
